description: A multi-skill creative plugin for source-aware image reconstruction, stickers, memes, and short motion.

defaultPrompt: Turn this photo into a clean transparent sticker with a white edge.
Reconstruct this image as a bold editorial print while preserving the subject.
Animate this image into a subtle five-second seamless loop.
interface.longDescription: MixMatter provides four focused creative Skills for source-aware image reconstruction, transparent stickers, captioned memes, and short motion. It works directly in chat and lets ChatGPT use the appropriate Skill for each request.

name: mixmatter
